def test_exact_llama_adoption_diagnostic():
    import json
    from functools import partial
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    from loguru import logger
    from tldw_chatbook.LLM_Management.llamacpp_connection import LlamaCppConnectionOwner,LlamaCppProbeResult
    from tldw_chatbook.UI.Navigation.llamacpp_handoff import LlamaCppConsoleIntent,owner_has_current_intent
    from tldw_chatbook.UI.Navigation.pending_handoff_store import PendingHandoffStore,HandoffChannel
    from tldw_chatbook.UI.Screens.chat_screen import ChatScreen
    owner=LlamaCppConnectionOwner();request=owner.begin('http://127.0.0.1:8001',runtime_owner='external_server',model_id='served-model');assert owner.accept(LlamaCppProbeResult(request,'ready',('served-model',),'served-model'));target=owner.snapshot().target;intent=LlamaCppConsoleIntent.from_target(target);assert owner_has_current_intent(owner,intent)
    store=PendingHandoffStore();revision=store.stage(HandoffChannel.LLAMACPP_CONSOLE,intent);entered=[];notices=[];logs=[]
    def ensure():entered.append(True);raise AssertionError('mutation path unexpectedly entered')
    app=SimpleNamespace(pending_handoffs=store,_llamacpp_connection_owner=owner,notify=lambda *a,**k:notices.append(a[0]))
    screen=SimpleNamespace(app_instance=app,is_attached=True,_ensure_console_chat_store=ensure)
    screen._consume_verified_console_intent=partial(ChatScreen._consume_verified_console_intent,screen)
    sink=logger.add(lambda m:logs.append(str(m)),format='{message}')
    try:result=ChatScreen.consume_pending_llamacpp_console_intent(screen)
    finally:logger.remove(sink)
    assert result is False and not entered and store.has_pending(HandoffChannel.LLAMACPP_CONSOLE)
    print(json.dumps(dict(exact_current_llama_intent=True,result=result,mutation_path_entries=len(entered),claim_remains_pending=store.has_pending(HandoffChannel.LLAMACPP_CONSOLE),revision=revision,notices=notices,logs=logs),indent=2))
